nodes.name: Section 21, Section 22, Proposition 17.3: § - Summability of $\mathcal V_{m2}$
nodes.statement:
Suppose that exactly one of the following assumptions is true. 
\begin{enumerate}[(a)] 
\item The parameter $\pmb{\Pi}$ obeys the hypotheses of Proposition 11.3, and  

the base $b$ lies in $\mathscr{B}_1$, the collection of bases given by (11.12). 

\item  The parameter $\pmb{\Pi}$ obeys the hypotheses of Proposition 4.5, 

and the base $b$ lies in $\mathscr{B}$, the collection of bases given by (4.20). 
\end{enumerate} 
For each pair $(\pmb{\Pi}, b)$ obeying either (V2-sum-prop-parta) or (V2-sum-prop-partb) above, and any $h \in \mathbb Z \setminus \{0\}$, there exists a sequence $\{\mathtt c_m(h, b) : m \geq 1\} \subseteq (0, \infty)$ for which the sum $\mathcal V_{m2}$ given by (17.6) satisfies the conclusion
\begin{equation} 
\mathcal V_{m2}(h, b) \leq \mathtt c_m(h, b) \; \; \text{ for all } m \geq 1, \; \; \text{ with } \; \; \sum_{m=1}^{\infty} \mathtt c_m(h, b) < \infty.  
\end{equation}
